{{Quote|That's Captain Ric Olié in ''Bravo One''. Battle-hardened at Chommell Minor.|Ars Veruna, pointing out ''Bravo 1'' to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="DP" />}}
A '''battle''' took place near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Chommell Minor/Legends|Chommell Minor]] between the newly formed [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]] and a [[Unidentified pirate group (Chommell Minor)|group of pirates]]. [[Ric Olié/Legends|Ric Olié]] took part in the battle in his new [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighter]], ''[[Bravo 1]]''. [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] quipped that several of the pirates collided with one another.<ref name="DP" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This battle was mentioned in [[2012]]'s [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']], which was written by [[James Luceno]].
